sentences.en: Good timing. I'll get you to test drive the new model.
sentences.zh: 1. 很好的时机。我这就安排你试驾新款车型。

sentences.en: In life as with omelets, the timing is important.
sentences.zh: 2. 生活就像煎蛋一样，时机很重要。

sentences.en: First, try to confirm the timing by oscilloscope.
sentences.zh: 3. 首先，试着用示波器确认一下时间同步。

senses.zh: 为…安排时间；测定…的时间（time的ing形式）
